_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/ledger/test_permanents_to_graveyard.py. t_gravebolt is Test Stormbolt with gravestorm in storm's place -- the same self spell_cast trigger on the stack, copying by permanents_to_graveyard_this_turn -- so the copy count can be read off the life it costs.

cards.name: Test Gravebolt
cards.oracle_text:
Test Gravebolt deals 1 damage to target player.
Gravestorm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each permanent put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.)

abilities.text: Gravestorm (When you cast this spell, copy it for each permanent put into a graveyard from the battlefield this turn. You may choose new targets for the copies.)
